last.verdict: Shopify grew revenue 32% and lifted its cash margin to 22%, meeting its own forecast, with growth cooling from last quarter's 34%.

takeaways.label: Growth steady, not accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 32% to $3.74 billion, in line with the low-thirties forecast and down from 34% last quarter. Sales volume on the platform rose 29% to $119 billion. The Q4 forecast is again low-thirties.

takeaways.label: Profit growing much faster
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 66% to $568 million, and free cash flow margin reached 22% versus 18% a year ago. Losses from payments and loans fell to $120 million from $148 million.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28%, slower than the 32% revenue growth, as lower-margin payments drove growth. Q4 gross profit is guided to the high-twenties.

takeaways.label: Large buyback begins
takeaways.text: Shopify spent $562 million repurchasing its own stock in the quarter, versus nothing a year ago. Cash and investments of about $4.7 billion remain.

history.verdict: Growth sped up and the outlook stayed strong, so a beaten-down stock jumped.

reasons.label: Growth speeding up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 34%, ahead of the high-twenties growth Shopify had guided for this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong profit and cash
reasons.text: Free cash flow margin reached 18%, up from 16%, and operating income rose 68%.

reasons.label: Confident next-quarter outlook
reasons.text: Shopify guided Q3 revenue growth to the low thirties and free cash flow margin to the high-teens to low-twenties.
